message.content:
Release gate: promote only if all checks pass.

| Area | Gate | Threshold |
|---|---|---|
| Correctness: target logits | Same prompt, seed, sampler, and MTP draft-1 settings vs CPU golden | Top-1 token match ≥ 99.9%; top-10 overlap ≥ 99.5%; max logit diff ≤ 1e-3 for FP16/integer path, or bit-exact if integer-only path is claimed |
| Correctness: MTP acceptance | Draft-1 acceptance and rollback behavior | Acceptance rate within ±1.0 pp of baseline; zero incorrect continuations after partial acceptance; rollback restores exact KV/recurrent state |
| Correctness: KV/recurrent state | Abort, partial accept, and re-prompt tests | 100% pass on 100 randomized prompts; no stale KV, recurrent, or draft-state leakage |
| Performance: CPU baseline | CPU generation with MTP draft-1 | No regression > 2% tokens/s vs current CPU baseline |
| Performance: Vulkan N=2 | Q2_K multi-column decode at N=2 | ≥ 5% tokens/s gain vs CPU baseline; no regression > 2% vs previous Vulkan N=2 |
| Performance: Vulkan N=4 | Q2_K multi-column decode at N=4 | No regression > 2% vs N=2 Vulkan; no regression > 2% vs CPU baseline |
| Performance: MTP overhead | Orchestration overhead for draft-1 | ≤ 5% of total decode time; no increase > 1% vs baseline |
| Stability: soak | 1-hour continuous decode with MTP, aborts, and device switches | 0 crashes, 0 hangs, 0 OOMs; RSS growth ≤ 1% over soak |
| Stability: rollback stress | 1,000 forced partial accepts/aborts | 100% correct state recovery; 0 corrupted KV/recurrent states |
| Fallback coverage: unsupported shapes | Non-Q2_K, non-N=2/N=4, missing MMVQ/int-dot, no cooperative matrices | 100% fall back to generic Vulkan or CPU; no crash, no silent wrong path |
| Fallback coverage: feature detection | MMVQ, integer dot product, FP16, AVX2/AVX-VNNI | 100% correct path selection; disabled features produce baseline behavior, not degraded correctness |
| Fallback coverage: shared-memory regression | CPU/Vulkan branch-overlap path | If shared LPDDR streaming is detected, disable overlap; no regression > 2% vs non-overlap baseline |

Hard blockers: any correctness mismatch, incorrect rollback, crash, OOM, hang, or fallback failure.
